This creature's critical hit threshold is lowered by [1] until the end of its turn.

To stop it, kill the creature, incapacitate it, or force it out of range before it can attack.

Massacre

Enemies sometimes get a turn in which they land critical hits far more often. That turn is always announced one turn ahead by Massacre Is Near.

A regular enemy can enter Massacre when its health drops below half. If it dies before it strikes, Massacre passes to the enemy nearest to it.

Bosses have a Massacre gauge instead. Their own turns, the deaths of their allies and lost health fill it, and it gets shorter after each Massacre.

Enable it?

On its next turn this creature enters <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_PLUS_RECKONING">Massacre</LSTag>. Incapacitate it or get your allies out of its reach. If a regular enemy dies first, Massacre passes to the enemy nearest to it.

When the gauge is full, this creature gets Massacre Is Near.

The gauge fills on each of its turns, each time one of its allies dies, and when its health drops below [1]% and below [2]%. Below [3]% it fills at once. After each Massacre the gauge gets shorter.
